# Independent source and execution plan

The current files freeze a proposed contract and literal grammar inputs for root
review. They do not contain generated expected outputs or product implementation.
The preserved PROPOSAL.md has the earlier parent/peer premise review; CONTRACT.md
and BYTES.md narrow Set78 to direct original-owner kernel + actual node/wallet
acceptance, leaving public TLS/runtime integration for later work.

Next, after root accepts these exact bytes, author a standalone Python producer
using only the frozen literal frames/inputs and standard integer/Fraction/hash/
JSON libraries. It must not import or run Go, read private stores, copy expected
bytes from product encoders, or call a node/network/clock/entropy source. Before
execution preserve its exact source and all input hashes; root owns execution
under two Python versions. Preserve every failed attempt and its input identities.

The independent producer uses exact integer LCM (bounded4096), checked explicit
API counts, all literal frame/key lengths, monotone row/financial upper bounds,
and an independent exhaustive0..4095 envelope check for the small fixed profile
set. The intended Go algorithm will instead use one initial fit check plus <=12 monotone probes (<=13 total). Output
includes all classified vectors, exact canonical reservation bytes and per-frame
budget diagnostics, proof of the2468/2490 fraction widths, request input/change
copies, the independent manager320MiB copy formula, longest report-state frame,
all-fit/none-fit search endpoints, and all prescribed edge/refusal cases. No generated output can claim
actual source topology, canonicality, financial readiness, or timing.

Product implementation begins only after root reviews the concrete contract and
independent producer/output. Its tests consume pinned reference output; they do
not write replacement expected bytes. Full V1 suites/old oracle remain unchanged.
Kernel integration uses actual original Source2/Round2/daily Store with normal
PoW fixture work, explicit controlled node observations and signed transaction
fixtures; a separate original-node/schema16 actual covers real expiry/canonical
acceptance and fresh-process exact pending recovery. Both fill derived selected
ordinary capacity and prove one new receipt/round/credit, A unchanged. No TLS,
public-host, unlimited lifetime, new payout-day/testclock or new custody claim.
